description: The user changed an Eisenhower Matrix: the whole matrix as the user left it. A new id starts a new matrix on the given day; for one already kept the day and from are ignored. A save that leaves no task deletes a kept matrix, and on a new id keeps nothing.

from.description: The day of the earlier matrix a new one was copied from, without its ticked tasks. Absent when the matrix started empty.

text.description: The task in the user's own words.

place.description: Where the user put the task: do (urgent and important), schedule (important, not urgent), delegate (urgent, not important) or drop (neither). Only ever set by the user; null while the user has not placed it.

done.description: Whether the user ticked the task.

tasks.description: The tasks, in the order they stand inside each place. A task carries no suggestion: only the matrices fact writes that, and keeps it while the task's words stay the same.

finished.description: True ends the stretch of typing, so the next change is an Undo step of its own (12, Undo): the view sends it when the user leaves a task's words or the sheet folds. Absent or false while the user is still typing.
